_doc: manualMap: override the default DtoName → ResponseName mapping. The default
is to strip 'Dto' and append 'Response' (e.g. PolicyDto → PolicyResponse).
Set the value to '' to mark a Dto as a pure-frontend type with no backend
counterpart (it'll be reported as 'skipped' in the script output).
ignoreDtos: same as setting manualMap[X] = '' — use whichever feels clearer.
allowList: per-Dto entries declaring intentional asymmetries.
- frontendOnly: field names the frontend declares but the backend doesn't.
Almost always indicates real drift (Jackson silently drops). Add here
only if the field is a UI-only projection that's intentionally never
- backendOnly: field names the backend ships but the frontend doesn't.
Common for fields the UI hasn't surfaced yet but that exist on the entity.
Adding here documents the intentional gap; remove when the field is wired.
- reason: free-text note that ends up in git blame for future reviewers.
The script doesn't enforce its presence but every entry below has one.
The current allowList is a Session 92 baseline — every entry represents
pre-existing drift that landed BEFORE the check was wired. Drive entries
down slice-by-slice; don't add new ones without strong justification.

CustomerDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. CustomerDto is a UI display projection (uses displayName + status convenience fields) while CustomerResponse carries the full domain (KYC fields, address breakdown, directors/documents arrays). Real reconciliation slice owed: align names + decide which backend fields to surface.

CustomerDirectorDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. fullName is a UI convenience; backend exposes firstName/lastName separately. Follow-up: drop fullName + reconcile.

EndorsementDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. EndorsementDto uses single sumInsured/premium fields while EndorsementResponse models the old-vs-new diff (oldSumInsured / newSumInsured / premiumAdjustment). UI doesn't expose the full diff today. Follow-up: redesign EndorsementDto to mirror the record shape.

QuoteDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. QuoteDto carries single-line totals (sumInsured/premium/discount/netPremium) while QuoteResponse models per-risk + quote-level loadings/discounts + workflow state. Session 91 fixed brokerName but the wider drift remains. Follow-up: full QuoteDto rewrite to mirror QuoteResponse.

QuoteRiskDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. quoteId is a UI back-reference convenience (server response wraps risks in the quote, no quoteId on each row). Follow-up: surface per-risk loadings/discounts + section info.

CompanySettingsDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. Field-name divergence (companyName vs name, logo vs logoPath) + missing RC/NAICOM/address fields on the frontend. Follow-up: realign + add the missing licence/address fields to the settings UI.

AccessGroupDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. userCount is computed UI-side (group's user list length). Backend audit timestamps could be added; not currently shown. Small follow-up.

ApprovalGroupDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. module is a UI alias for entityType. The level-level fields (levelOrder/approverUserId/approverName/maxAmount) shouldn't be at the top level — they belong on ApprovalLevelDto. Follow-up: ApprovalGroup reshape + alias removal.

ProductDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. Multi-risk product sections aren't surfaced in the back-office Products page yet (used by RisksEditorDialog through a separate endpoint). Surface when there's a section-editor UI.

ClassOfBusinessDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. `products` is a frontend-computed count (joined client-side). Backend's description + audit timestamps not shown today. Small follow-up.

BankDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. Audit timestamps not shown in the banks list.

CurrencyDto.reason: Session 92 baseline. isDefault + audit timestamps not shown in the currencies list.
